summary: Farmer Mac filed an 8-K reporting the completion of an exempt public offering of 4,000,000 shares of 6.875% Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock, Series I. The sale was made under an underwriting agreement dated May 12, 2026, with Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC as representative of the underwriters. Terms include a 6.875% dividend rate, non-cumulative, with no stated price per share or premium disclosed. No board recommendation or advisor referenced beyond the underwriter. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special-situation event. Watch for subsequent dividend payments and potential future issuance; no risk-arb angle applies.
